title: Arabic Inscription
brief_description: Persian Inscription on a basalt slab
detailed_description: Persian Inscription on a basalt slab dated Hijri year 1001, Ramzan 12 (1593 A.D., June 2)Dynasty: Mughal Ruler: Akbar Damaged on the upper portion and lower left portion. Refers to the order of Zahiruddin and mentions some officials Sarlashkar Mubarizuddin Farhad Khan, Sarnaubat Itimadud Daula Azam Khan and Itibar Khan in connection with the royal trench (alang-i-khas).
